name: io.tradeops.mcp.tradeops-core
title: TradeOps Core
description: Tenant-scoped CFS warehouse operations, slot allocation, inventory queries, and bonded ledger tools backed by the TradeOps database.

tools.name: server.discover
tools.description: Return protocol versions, capabilities, and tool-list signature.

tools.name: gate.in
tools.description: Record gate-in; MRTR for weighbridge/ANPR exceptions.

tools.name: gate.out
tools.description: Record gate-out; MRTR if bonded goods remain.

tools.name: inventory.allocate
tools.description: Atomically allocate an available slot to a container.

tools.name: inventory.query
tools.description: Query inventory by lot, batch, or serial metadata.

tools.name: ledger.entry
tools.description: Post a bonded-ledger entry and update its CIF balance.

tools.name: ledger.reconcile
tools.description: Check bonded-ledger balance chains for a date range.

tools.name: yard.status
tools.description: Read current slot occupancy and measured gate-event dwell times.

tools.name: tasks.update
tools.description: Resume an owned task waiting for input.
